newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent dips, volume slight, range trading.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent dips, volume slight, range trading.

text.p: Brent crude futures were slightly lower in late trading on SIMEX on Tuesday in extended range trading.
July Brent was last traded at $19.47 per barrel, down five cents from London overnight. Volume was just 13 lots. August was traded one lot at $19.55, down four from London.
July NYMEX was last traded on ACCESS at $20.96, down two cents from New York. Volume was 513 lots.
Brokers said the market was stalled in the midst of range trading.
Technically it was well supported by a potential reverse head and shoulders forming on both Brent and NYMEX front month charts.
But fundamentally, traders said there was little direction, although there was some lingering speculation that funds remained long in the market.
